name: Child's Pose

instructions.description: Kneel on the mat and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest toward the floor as far as comfortable.
Let your neck relax and breathe slowly into the back and sides of the rib cage.
Walk your hands back and return to upright kneeling when finished.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use calm breathing during the hold.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Place a pillow or bolster under the trunk for comfort.

commentsNotes: Separate the knees slightly if the hips feel crowded.
Come out slowly if knees or ankles become uncomfortable.
